labels.text: section 4941(c)(2): the maximum amount of the tax imposed by subsection (a)(2) or (b)(2), with respect to any one act of self-dealing, is $20,000

$20,000, raised from $10,000 by Pub. L. 109-280 section 1212(f), applicable to taxable years beginning after August 17, 2006 per the pinned note IRC_S4941_NOTE_6. The pre-2006 $10,000 cap is NOT modelled (SOURCE_GAP for that period).
